name: royal-nightmare
author: Lil Art
description: A solo challenge in a nightmare version of Prontera, for Base Level 230 and up. Fight through two hordes of the Nightmare Queen's cursed townspeople, then her Death Witches, and finally Demi Freyja, within a 60-minute limit shown on screen. Clearing it opens a reward chest; it can be run again after 8 hours. One player at a time. Renewal only.
